decision.covered_scope: Removal of non-owned flood-borne debris (stones) from underneath the insured building to the perimeter of the building in the yard
decision.evidence_needed: Additional evidence that the estimated dollar amount from the contractor is limited to the covered scope of work; other debris removal estimates from one or more different contractors to validate the $3,564 per cubic yard price with sales tax
decision.excluded_scope: Transportation, handling, disposal, and yard-work components outside the perimeter footprint; barge transportation costs
decision.prior_claim_check: Review documentation for previous claims filed on May 20, 2019, May 29, 2019, and June 11, 2019 to verify if debris removal for the same area underneath the building was performed before the July 2019 flood event

findings.evidence: FEMA agrees SFIP covers cost to remove flood-borne debris such as stones deposited underneath the insured building's perimeter footprint
findings.title: Coverage for Debris Removal Underneath Building

findings.evidence: SFIP does not cover expense to dispose non-owned debris, nor increased cost to remove debris in the yard or cart debris into a barge
findings.title: Exclusion of Transport and Disposal Costs

findings.evidence: Contractor quote of $3,564 per cubic yard requires validation through additional estimates from different contractors
findings.title: Price Support Requirement

findings.evidence: Policyholder must provide proof of repairs and price from three previous flood claims to ensure against payment overlap
findings.title: Prior Claim Overlap Verification

headline: FEMA Affirms Partial Coverage for Flood-Borne Debris Removal Under Insured Building
next_actions: Insurer to review policyholder's amended proof of loss totaling $182,552.00
Insurer to verify prior claim payments for debris removal from underneath the building
Insurer to request additional contractor estimates to validate removal pricing
Insurer to deny excluded transport, handling, and disposal components
Insurer to direct payment only for covered under-building removal labor and equipment usage
